name: narminhasanli
description: Convenience scripts to run server/ and client-next/ together. Not a pnpm workspace -- each package still has its own node_modules/.env.

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir server install && pnpm --dir client-next install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "pnpm --dir server dev" "pnpm --dir client-next dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir server lint && pnpm --dir client-next lint
